meshy_tasks.prompt: Veridian, the legendary Heart of the Meadows stag creature for a stylised 3D creature-collecting action RPG, the SAME character, same body shape, same pose and same proportions as the grey-background 3D model render, repainted with the colours and markings of the board illustration. HIDE: the body, flanks, back, belly, hips and upper legs are a smooth warm cream-ivory hide (#E8E2C8), clean and pale. MOSS: rich deep green moss and leaves (#3f7a3a to #5a9a48) ONLY on the neck and chest mane, a short shoulder cape over the withers, and the lower-leg boots just above the hooves; nowhere else on the body. FILIGREE: thin elegant metallic GOLD filigree swirls (#c9a646) traced over the shoulders, flanks and hips like fine ornamental lines, no thick vines, no brown bark cages. A single glowing TEAL gem (#35c4b5) set in a gold mount at the centre of the chest. ANTLERS: warm brown wood antlers (#7a5a3a) with lighter tips and a few small green leaves near the base. TAIL: short, pale cream on top with a white underside like a deer tail. HEAD: cream face with a dark brown-black muzzle and nose, darker inner ears, a clear dark readable eye with a small white catchlight. Dark grey-brown hooves. Stylised hand-painted creature-game look with clean readable colour blocks, Palworld / Pokemon Legends style 3D render, not photoreal. Full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no scenery, no text. Absolutely no red, pink, coral, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Single creature only.

review: Blender EEVEE turntable before/after inspected by the worker: cream hide, moss mane/cape/boots, gold filigree, teal gem, brown antlers and dark muzzle read; tail and antler silhouettes unchanged. No red.
